items.title: Steve "Ted" Brown Interview, 1958-04-22
items.q: Ray Mueller, who played at the College Inn, and later on joined Whiteman.

ctx.x: If you can play some of those old records, Amanda, I wonder first, though, if you have anything more to add about Tom going to Chicago, since he's not here to speak for himself, anything else that you think he wanted to know about himself and the things that he originated and first started?

Well, I was away from Tom and all the boys at that particular time and in a different line of business entirely with Chief Metalworks, so therefore, I can order to tell you what he'd write and how the band was going along and what letters that I received from Ray Lopez, who would write me now and then. Gus Mule would never write me, and Tom would very seldom write me at that time. But Ray Lopez told me, he says, you know, he said, when we first got to Chicago, he says, the people thought we were drunk. They…
We're trying to get to talk to Ray. And he's out in Hawthorne? Hawthorne, California.
